reranker.score: raw logit, higher = more relevant (model card); sigmoid is monotone
reranker.pair: (query text, document text of the cutoff index)

variant_def.base: retriever as is (BM25 scores / RRF scores)
variant_def.ce@N: top-N by cross-encoder score, tail N+1.. in retriever order, scores 1/(1+rank)
variant_def.ce_rrf@N: top-N by RRF(retriever rank, cross-encoder rank), rrf_k as pg_retriever

slice_def.new_name: normalized first position not a name of the cutoff index
